run_log_regression_eval: run DINOv2 logistic regression evaluation on ImageNet using cuML with frozen features
create_LogRegModule: create a cuML-based logistic regression module with configurable C, max_iter, dtype, and device
sweep_C_values: sweep regularization C values across a range to find the best hyperparameter for logistic regression
eval_log_regression_with_model: evaluate a DINOv2 model by training logistic regression on extracted frozen features
train_for_C: train a logistic regression model with a specific C regularization value on given features and labels
